svg.title: StudyPat · School website and branding · Mockups
School website builder (mockup)
svg.text: Choose sections, colours and pictures. Your site updates when you save.

svg.title: Install as an app (PWA) (mockup)
svg.text: Open it like any app. Works on a slow line.
On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”
Personal data is never kept offline by mistake.

svg.title: Custom domain and white label (mockup)
svg.text: Show your school’s name everywhere. Available on the Enterprise plan.
Point your domain to StudyPat, then press Check
Add these two records at your domain company
Hide StudyPat from your parents and staff
White label needs: the switch on, the Enterprise plan, and an active domain. If one is missing, normal branding shows.
